profile.Name: Screamer the False
profile.Personality: Intelligent, sadistic, and scornful of humans. He welcomes Skeleton "volunteers" as subjects and sets his thralls on human intruders.
profile.Backstory: He rules the Thrall Masters with Ponk from the Tower of Abuse, where lasers guard the approach, and carries a fine heavy polearm. The United Cities and the Holy Nation want the pair as the Voodoo Brothers, con artists who posed as healers and voodoo practitioners in many cities.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Dry and condescending. He mocks humans who reach him and gives clipped commands like "Thralls: Exterminate."
